A '''power flux dispersion unit''' was a part of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] internal mechanism. Attached to the [[apas connector]]s, it dissipated flashback energy during the weapon's discharge, preventing the blaster from exploding.<ref name="CRFG" />
